current_policy.normalization: I_ref = g_leak * (V_onset - V_rest) from frozen Electrical Model V1 class parameters; square current at selected source cells; no change to model weights/delays/boundary

protocol.deterministic_replay: Repeat the first pulse for every arm, level and seed from the identical unperturbed checkpoint; compare complete trial records byte-for-byte after canonical JSON serialization.

stage_criteria.DN_inhibitory_prediction: In at least one DN, the full arm must lose spikes or delay its first post-arrival spike relative to MBON-output-disconnected D in at least five of ten matched pulses for every seed; summed post-window spike count may not exceed D. No paired DN difference may precede first MBON arrival. Apply the same criterion to F versus F_off for the direct probe.

protocol.trial_policy: Each pulse is an independent clone of the same seed's unperturbed checkpoint at its onset; no prior pulse enters a later trial. Matched branches share the complete initial neural/boundary state and pulse timing.
